content: Agent looked up Ludicolo competitive data but Ludicolo is NOT in Pokemon Champions Reg M-A. Check availability before calling tools on Pokemon names.
Kingdra is NOT in Pokemon Champions. Do not include or look up. Alternatives: Basculegion, Gyarados, Milotic.
Ferrothorn is NOT in Champions. Use Archaludon (Steel/Dragon) or Kingambit instead.
Rain teams should include Archaludon as the special attacker anchor. It's S-tier. Missing it means a weaker team.
Pelipper + Politoed is redundant. Use only 1 rain setter (Pelipper). Second slot should be a rain abuser like Basculegion or rain-immune Pokemon like Dragonite.
Use Swift Swim, NOT Adaptability, on rain teams. Swift Swim doubles speed in rain for speed control.
Every team suggestion should end with a Matchup Analysis section: VS Sun, VS Rain Mirror, VS Sand, VS Trick Room, VS Fairy. Each matchup should specify LEAD + BACK + turn 1-2 game plan.

Agent should cross-reference Bulbapedia's Champions Pokemon list (https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/List_of_Pok%C3%A9mon_in_Pok%C3%A9mon_Champions) when uncertain about Pokemon availability. Use fetch_reference tool.
Sneasler is S-tier in Champions. It OHKOs Steel types (Archaludon, Kingambit, Tyranitar) with Close Combat. Include it in most teams unless there's a specific reason not to.
Incineroar with Intimidate + Fake Out + Parting Shot fits on almost every team. It's the default glue Pokemon.
